entryMethod: Title/pause Cheats menu — toggle list (codes optional). Multiple cheats stack unless noted.

cheats.name: Instant struggle meter fill
cheats.effect: Struggle meter fills to full immediately when trapped / on tap path — instant escape.

cheats.name: All items in shop free
cheats.effect: All katanas, armors, and upgrades cost 0 and unlock.

cheats.name: Half struggle fill rate
cheats.effect: Struggle taps fill at half rate (challenge).

cheats.name: Double tickle damage
cheats.effect: All enemy tickleDamagePerSecond doubled (incl. grab DPS).

cheats.name: Double projectile damage
cheats.effect: All projectileTickleDamagePerSecond doubled. Stacks with double tickle if both on.

compendium.note: Compendium/Gallery lists every zombie with display name, idle sprite, and all struggle-1..3 + gameover-1..3 cinematics (plus projectile packs where separate).
